transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Ever since they changed my position at the shop, I just can’t seem to adjust, and it’s throwing off my work and my whole routine. It feels like everything has been turned upside down, and I'm really struggling to get a grip on it.
How long ago did this change in your work position happen, and when did you start feeling this way?

The change at the shop happened about a month ago when they restructured my position. I started feeling this way almost immediately—within a week or two of being switched to the new line and supervisor. It has been going on constantly ever since then.
Besides the stress at work, have you been experiencing a persistently low mood or a loss of interest in activities you normally enjoy?

Yes, I've been feeling incredibly defeated and on the verge of tears, and I've completely lost interest in the things I used to love. I've stopped paddle-boarding and playing pickleball, and instead of working on my metal sculptures, I just sit on the couch staring at my unfinished work.
Along with feeling down and losing interest in your hobbies, have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns or your energy levels lately?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep patterns. I just feel incredibly drained and defeated after a shift at work, like I have absolutely no energy left for anything else.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight, or have you been having difficulty concentrating on tasks since these work changes happened?

I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or weight. And while I feel incredibly unmotivated and defeated right now, I haven't had any distinct issues with my concentration itself.
Have you been experiencing any strong feelings of worthlessness, or have you been blaming yourself excessively for the difficulties you're facing at work?

I don't really feel worthless or blame myself for the restructuring, since those changes were completely forced on me by the company. I mostly just feel incredibly defeated, overwhelmed, and frustrated by these new quotas and how they've thrown off my entire routine.
During this difficult time, have you had any thoughts of death, or felt like you would be better off not being here?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or wanting to die. I'm just feeling incredibly overwhelmed and stuck with this whole work situation right now.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient developed emotional symptoms, including depressed mood, loss of interest in hobbies, and feelings of being overwhelmed, in response to an identifiable psychosocial stressor (work restructuring and change in supervisor) that occurred one month ago. The symptoms began within two weeks of the stressor and have caused significant functional impairment (e.g., stopping social and recreational activities). The presentation does not meet the full diagnostic criteria for a major depressive episode, pointing to Adjustment Disorder (F43.2) as the most accurate diagnosis.
